prompt: Create a polished semi-realistic anime portrait of a cute young cat-eared girl standing in a bright, elegant room. She has short wavy navy-blue hair with soft lavender highlights, large clear blue eyes, fair skin with a gentle blush, and a small shy smile. Add two fluffy cat ears on top of her head, dark blue outside and white fur inside, plus exactly 2 red ribbon hair ornaments, one hanging beside each ear with thin trailing ties. Dress her in a graceful layered Japanese kimono-inspired outfit: a pale pink inner robe, a soft powder-blue outer haori with wide sleeves, subtle embroidered white patterns along the sleeves and trim, a gray-lavender obi, and a small coral-red bow at the waist. Her pose is relaxed and slightly tilted toward the viewer, hands lowered at her sides, with an innocent calm expression. Set the scene in a softly lit interior beside a large window on the left with sheer cream curtains and warm morning sunlight streaming in. Include exactly 5 visible table items in the lower left: 2 pale blue teacups on saucers, 1 small vase of white roses, 1 rectangular wooden tray, and 1 tabletop edge. In the background, show a softly blurred framed painting on the wall, muted architectural trim, and a hint of greenery, all with shallow depth of field. Use delicate linework, luminous pastel colors, detailed fabric texture, realistic light bloom, soft shadows, and a dreamy high-detail gpt-image-2 anime illustration style. Vertical portrait composition, waist-up to three-quarter view, centered character, no text, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一张精致的半写实动漫肖像，描绘一位站在明亮优雅房间里的可爱猫耳少女。她拥有 带有淡紫色挑染的短波浪深蓝色头发、明亮清澈的蓝色大眼睛、白皙且略带红晕的皮肤，以及羞涩的微笑。在她的头顶添加一对毛茸茸的猫耳，外侧为深蓝色，内侧为白色绒毛；并加上 2 个红色丝带发饰，分别垂在每只耳朵旁，带有细长的飘带。为她穿上一套优雅的日式和服风格叠穿服饰：淡粉色内衬、浅粉蓝色外罩衫（羽织），袖口和边缘带有精致的白色刺绣图案，搭配灰紫色腰带，腰间系有一个珊瑚红色的小蝴蝶结。她的姿态放松，身体微微向观众倾斜，双手自然垂在身侧，表情天真宁静。场景设定在光线柔和的室内，左侧有一扇大窗户，挂着奶油色薄纱窗帘，温暖的晨光倾泻而入。在左下方包含 5 个清晰可见的桌面物品：2 个淡蓝色茶杯及托盘、1 个插有白玫瑰的小花瓶、1 个长方形木托盘以及 1 个桌面边缘。背景中展示一幅虚化的墙上挂画、柔和的建筑线条以及少许绿植，营造出浅景深效果。采用细腻的线条、明亮的淡色调、细致的布料纹理、写实的溢光效果、柔和的阴影，以及梦幻般的高细节 gpt-image-2 动漫插画风格。竖构图肖像，半身至七分身视角，角色居中，无文字，无水印。
